_doc: Capabilities of features/admin/organization.ts CAPABILITIES that are READY, i.e. wired to a PUBLISHED backend contract (docs/parallel/c0/ORGANIZATION_API_CONTRACT_FOR_C5.md, D-C0-52). Wired by C5 against the typed transport api.org (packages/api-client/src/org.ts). A capability becomes READY only by changing BOTH this list and CAPABILITIES in the same commit (the fail-closed guard and tests/builder/organization-fail-closed.test.ts compare them), so a route can never appear by accident. NOT offered (NOT_SUPPORTED, no capability): hard delete of a unit, employee profile fields, tenant-global position, editing an employee identity.
